en: Sepia-toned historical postcard showing a low stone structure and spring or fountain beside a shallow body of water in an open, barren landscape. Two men in early 20th‑century attire stand on the stone platform, while another figure and animals appear in the distance. The lower margin contains printed captions in Greek and French identifying the scene as a picturesque view of Macedonia and the Fountain of Alexander the Great at Yenidje-Vardar.
